'''Plennid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Republic Diplomatic Corps]] [[Minister]] during the period of time known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Plennid was traveling through the [[Deucalon Spaceport]] Plaza when he and his bodyguards were ambushed by the [[Kintan Kings]], a violent [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] gang who controlled large portions of the area. Plennid's bodyguards were killed, and, several [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] passcodes were on the bodies and were stolen and looted from by the violent gang. Desperate for some form of help, Plennid asked a traveling [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-aligned hero if they could recover the passcodes. The hero succeeded, and defeated several Niktos in the process. Plennid then asked the hero to report to [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Averdon]] in the [[Promenade]] region.
